name: okf-staleness-check
description: Daily audit of the BlackAgents OKF knowledge layer — staleness, broken links and missing provenance — filing re-verification proposals into the Brain inbox.
task: Audit the workspace knowledge layer: scan <workspace>/.black-agents/knowledge/ for OKF v0.2 concepts, flag overdue stale_after, unverified provenance and broken concept links, file re-verification proposals into the Brain inbox, and report the findings.

steps.instructions: Scan every concept under .black-agents/knowledge/ (excluding index.md and log.md). Check stale_after dates, generated/verified provenance, links to non-existent concepts, and OKF v0.2 frontmatter validity. For each overdue concept, and each concept generated after its latest verification, call brain_propose_reverification with the concept id and clear evidence. The tool only creates a pending Brain inbox item; it never edits or verifies knowledge. Never use a general file-write tool. Report malformed frontmatter as an error.

Consolidate the audit output into a single markdown report: concepts scanned, overdue, unverified, broken links, malformed files, and the proposals filed (or emitted). Keep it to a table plus a 3-line summary.
